meta.protocol: tr_lib.tapes(n), 300 random tapes per cell, n in [512, 1024, 2048], rules (pattern, runs, peak), k in [1, 2, 3, 4]
meta.model: BTHM-C_k, ONE model with k a real parameter: the oracle answers the EXACT visit count of the quadruple (ell, r, L, R); the rule reads the count mod k (k colour-variants, colour 0 = first visit); the repair fires when the count is positive and count mod k == 0, i.e. on the (k+1)-th visit, so k visits are played before the trim.  k = 1 is the colour-blind model (repair on the 2nd visit) and reproduces probe_trim/cut_cells.json; k = 4 is probe_colour's BTHM-C_4 and reproduces probe_colour/col_cells.json.
meta.design: FIXED across k: variant c = mirror the move when c is odd (LPLUS<->RMINUS, LMINUS<->RPLUS; trims and halt fixed) plus swap the cut side when c is 2 or 3 (CUTL<->CUTR).  k=2: c in {0,1}, only the mirror acts, repair on the 3rd visit.  k=3: c in {0,1,2}, mirror at c=1, swap at c=2, repair on the 4th visit.  k=4: c in {0,1,2,3}, mirror at 1 and 3, swap at 2 and 3, repair on the 5th visit.  A move that would leave the region is replaced by a cut on the side the (mapped) move would leave for c in {0,1}, on the opposite side for c in {2,3}; the double cut when the window fills the region is kept for every colour.  The repair reads the side off the colour-0 (base) table.
meta.charge: pcr_lib INC accounting; the colour is free and takes no step; a repair pays the re-span a rule-initiated cut pays (abs(y-L)+abs(x-R_) plus the head re-read).
meta.rescue: cap-diers = the tapes that die at the cap in BTHM-0 (end0 = 4) -- the colour-blind baseline set on which bC_rescue_frac of probe_trim/cut_cells.json is computed; rescue_frac = the fraction of those that end in a meet under (rule, k).  rescue_no_trim = rescued cap-diers with ntrim == 0.
